newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Four killed in Karachi violence.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Karachi violence.

text.p: At least four people, including a woman, were shot dead in separate incidents of violence on Monday in Pakistan's industrial port city of Karachi, police said.

All the incidents occurred in the city's District East. The unidentified woman was killed in Gulistan-e-Jauhar neighbourhood, a 25-year-old man in Korangi, a young man in Ibrahim Hyderi and an aged man in Steel Town, police said.
Nobody claimed responsibility and there was no immediate information about the motive of the killings, which followed a series of incidents of ethnic and sectarian violence.
The ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM), now part of a coalition government in Sindh province, of which Karachi is the capital, has long feuded with the breakaway Haqiqi faction.
Some 75 people have been killed in ethnic, political and sectarian violence in Karachi this year compared to 500 last year and about 2,000 in 1995.
